context:
The simulations describe heat transport in a stationary bar whose material composition varies smoothly with position. The field u is temperature departure from a reference temperature. Heat capacity is uniform and normalized to one; there is no volumetric heating during observation. Both endpoint temperatures are prescribed. One record follows cooling after internal heating with both ends at the reference temperature. A second starts at the reference temperature and follows a smooth rise and hold of the left endpoint temperature. The observations have no added measurement noise.

The constitutive law and spatial coefficient field are unknown. Infer a model that predicts temperature when the initial heated region is moved or the warming program is applied at the opposite end. The material distribution, scales and fitted law remain fixed.

coordinates.grid: Uniform observed nodes including both endpoints.

records.role: Heat the interior region x in [0.15,0.75], then watch redistribution with both endpoints held at reference temperature.
Start at reference temperature and smoothly warm the left endpoint, then hold it fixed.
